title: Team and roles
description: Who is helping and what each person can see. Access to finance and to private requests is granted separately, person by person.

roleHelp.owner: Decides everything: the team, access, the date and deleting the occasion.
roleHelp.pm: Runs the plan with the owner: tasks, team, date.
roleHelp.workstream_lead: Leads one part of the plan and can hand out tasks.
roleHelp.contributor: Adds tasks and looks after the ones they accept.
roleHelp.supplier: Sees the plan and updates the tasks given to them.
roleHelp.guest: Sees the plan and the tasks given to them.

fields.label: What you call them
fields.labelHint: A free label shown beside the role.
fields.grantsHint: These do not come with the role. Tick only what the person needs to see.
fields.emailHint: We send an invitation link that is valid for 14 days.

grants.financeHint: Sees and changes the budget and shared costs.
grants.privateRequestsHint: Sees guests' private requests (allergies, special needs).

fresh.title: First confirm it is you
fresh.body: Roles, access to finance and private requests, removing someone and handing over the occasion all need a fresh confirmation.

invite.title: Invite to the team
invite.sentTitle: The invitation is on its way
invite.sentBody: The person is listed under “Invitations sent” until they accept. You can invite someone else below.
invite.suppressedTitle: The invitation is saved, but the email was not sent
invite.suppressedBody: That address no longer receives email from us. Check it or use another one.

remove.intro: The person loses access to the occasion at once. Their tasks stay in the plan without an owner, and unanswered offers are withdrawn.
remove.introInvite: The link in the email will stop working.
remove.title: Remove this person from the team?
remove.body: {name} will no longer see the occasion. Their tasks have no owner until you give them to someone else.
remove.bodyInvite: The invitation for {name} can no longer be accepted.

transfer.intro: The new owner gets every right, including deleting the occasion. You stay on the team as project manager.
transfer.title: Hand over the occasion?
transfer.body: {name} becomes the owner. You stay as project manager, without automatic access to finance or private requests.

members.title: On the team
members.alone: It is just you for now. Invite someone to share the tasks.

rolesGuide.title: What each role can do
rolesGuide.grantsNote: The budget, shared costs and guests' private requests are not visible from any role except the owner. They are granted separately, to each person.

member.title: Team member
member.pending: Invited as {role} — has not accepted yet

accept.goneTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
accept.goneBody: The link has already been used, was cancelled or is not correct. Ask the owner for a new invitation.
accept.eyebrow: You have been invited to the team
accept.body: You are invited to help plan, as {role}.
accept.label: Your label: {label}.
accept.expiredBody: Ask the owner to send it again.
accept.signInBody: After you sign in we bring you back here to accept the invitation.

email.subject: Invitation to the team of “{occasion}”
email.intro: You have been invited to help plan “{occasion}”, as: {role}.
email.validity: The link is valid for {days} days and can be used once.
email.notExpected: If you were not expecting this invitation you can ignore it. Nothing happens until you accept.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change roles, grant access or appoint project managers.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already on the team.
errors.inviteGone: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
errors.inviteExpired: The invitation has expired. Ask the owner to send it again.
errors.ownerRoleFixed: The owner role only changes through “Hand over the occasion”.
errors.ownerCannotLeave: The owner cannot be removed. Hand the occasion over to someone else first.
errors.notJoined: The person has to accept the invitation first.
